title: a build with agents_md: exclude launches claude with CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_CLAUDE_MDS=1 in its environment
source: intended: PLAN.md defect S2 (agents_md); jitso/presets/haiku-explorer.yaml agents_md: exclude; the TS launcher only logs the field
intent: INTENDED behavior (defect S2, agents_md). The variable is documented at code.claude.com/docs/en/env-vars as preventing the load of any CLAUDE.md memory files (user, project, auto). A headless canary test on Claude Code 2.1.325 measured that it also stops the native AGENTS.md read and the @AGENTS.md import; this case pins only that the variable is in claude's environment. On TS the field is only logged (registry agents_md) and the variable is never set, so the env check FAILS on TS.
